# 2. Czyszczenie danych

## 2.1. Braki danych
```{r}

mcar_test(data[1:5000,])

vis_miss(data, warn_large_data = FALSE)

```

```{r}
gg_miss_var(data, show_pct = TRUE)

gg_miss_upset(data)

```

```{r}

gg_miss_fct(data, fct = Parking)

```

```{r}
unique(data$Parking)


data %>%
  group_by(Parking) %>%
  miss_var_summary()

```
```{r}
gg_miss_span(
  data,
  Price,
  span_every = 2000,
  facet = Garage
)
```
